task: Find the full received wavelength interval as the tuning capacitance varies from 12 through 450 pF, with fixed L=2e-4 H. Not a frequency-only task, not a single wavelength, and not an interval inferred from the detector shunt capacitor.
figure_use: The two specified PNGs were each actually opened once. The original has an unadjusted coil and an arrow across the tuning capacitor, plus a detector, separate fixed capacitor, and both rightmost earpieces. The complete modern PNG visibly labels the tuning coil L and adjustable capacitor C. All relevant circuit elements and the bottom return/ground are visible. Identification labels do not supply wavelength values. This is task interpretation/leakage evidence only; existing source/math-fidelity PASS is neither reopened nor reissued.
independent_solution: Ideal LC resonance obeys L*d2q/dt2+q/C=0, so omega0=1/sqrt(LC), f0=1/(2*pi*sqrt(LC)), T0=2*pi*sqrt(LC). With radio propagation approximated by c=3e8 m/s in vacuum/near-vacuum air, lambda=c/f0=2*pi*c*sqrt(LC). For fixed positive L, d(lambda)/dC=pi*c*sqrt(L)/sqrt(C)>0, so Cmin determines lambda_min and Cmax determines lambda_max. 1 pF=1e-12 F; 12 pF=1.2e-11 F and 450 pF=4.5e-10 F. At 12 pF, LC=2.4e-15 H F, T=3.0781195923884737e-7 s, f=3248736.671806984 Hz and lambda=92.34358777165421 m. At 450 pF, LC=9e-14 H F, T=1.884955592153876e-6 s, f=530516.4769729844 Hz and lambda=565.4866776461628 m. Thus the ideal-model wavelength range is approximately 92.3 to 565.5 m (or 92 to 565 m to whole metres), with included endpoint settings. Numerical endpoints are approximate, not exact empirical bandwidth boundaries.

truth_basis.authority: Seed givens, observed tuning-component identification, ideal LC differential equation and lambda=c/f; no author agreement used as proof.
truth_basis.interval_direction: Increasing wavelength versus capacitance; frequency endpoints run in the opposite direction.
truth_basis.rounding: Whole-metre endpoints 92 and 565; any book-level coarse approximation must be labelled approximate, not promoted to an exact answer.

exact_c_sensitivity.observation: Using exact vacuum c shifts each endpoint by about 0.0692%; it does not change endpoint ordering or the whole-metre range.

truth_basis.assumptions: Ideal lumped LC tuning; neglect resistance, stray capacitance, detector/antenna loading and dispersion. Treat reception as resonance tuning, not a measured real receiver passband.
truth_basis.grading_boundary: Review standard-display content only. Do not invent auto-grading parts or expected values; ungraded may remain a deliberate author/native boundary.
